meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 信息安全分析师与软件开发工程师在搭建文档处理流水线时，当需要拦截违规文件或外部URL，请挂载此技能作为强制前置安检，自动输出 pass/reject 判定与详细合规扫描报告，一键守住零信任安全底线。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动拦截文档流水线中的违规文件与外部URL，输出合规扫描报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在搭建文档处理流水线，需要拦截违规文件或外部URL以保障安全。
copy.tagline_en: Block bad files and URLs in document pipelines and output compliance reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build document pipelines and need to block bad files or URLs for security.

howto.what: 装上后,任何文件或外部 URL 进入文档处理流水线前会先过一道安检:输出 pass 或 reject 判定,附命中黑名单项、许可状态与风险等级的扫描报告,并生成 trace_id 留痕。
howto.when: 当本地文件(PDF/PPT/Excel/Word/图片)或外部 URL 进入文档处理系统、需要拦截违规来源时,由锦衣卫 Worker 调用,作为流水线的第一道闸门。

say.text: 这个外部 URL 合规吗,先解析域名再判定
扫描服务连不上时不要放行,直接拒绝并告警
say.note: 零信任底线,不降级放行

howto.what_en: Once installed, files or external URLs pass a security check before entering a document pipeline: it outputs a pass/reject verdict with a report (blacklist hits, license status, risk level) and a trace_id.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a local file (PDF/PPT/Excel/Word/image) or external URL enters a document system and needs blocking of non-compliant sources; called by the Jinyiwei Worker as the pipeline's first gate.

say_en.text: Scan /path/a.pdf and give me a pass or reject verdict
Is this external URL compliant? Resolve the domain first
If the scan service is down, reject and alert, never pass
